messages:
sara: rolled out v3.14 to us-west canaries ~5m ago. quick sanity glance looked fine but smoketests flagged something on the embed route.

deploy-bot: Deploy v3.14 completed to canaries (6/6). tagged release: v3.14.0.

smokebot: synthetic-check started -> route /v1/embed returned 3 failures out of 5 samples. avg latency higher than baseline.

liam: i'm seeing 503s in the proxy logs from two hosts (usw-can-03, usw-can-05). stacktrace points to upstream timeout / kv prefill misses.

ana whoops typo -> ana: tagging for visibility. can we rerun the targeted synthetic against only the affected canaries?

sara: starting a focused rerun against usw-can-03/05 now. will paste commands.

sara: ```bash
# local quick repro against canary node
curl -sS -X POST https://usw-can-05.api.redwood/v1/embed \  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \  -d '{"input":"test-probe"}' \  -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code} T:%{time_total}\n"
```

sara: result (x3): HTTP:503 T:0.23, HTTP:503 T:0.21, HTTP:200 T:0.18 (intermittent).

liam: grabbing host logs now. snippet: ```ERROR upstream_unavailable shard=12 timeout=1200ms route=/v1/embed correlation=xxxx```

ana -> ana: hypothesis: prefill job for some cache prefixes didn't finish on the new hosts during startup, so first requests spike misses and time out.

liam: agree. i kicked the prefill script to target prefixes for embed models on usw-can-03/05. script output: "prefill started -> 3 prefixes queued -> completed for host" on both.

sara: rerunning the focused synthetic after prefill...

smokebot: synthetic-check (re-run) -> 5/5 success for /v1/embed on both hosts. p50/p95 within expected.

ana: decision time: we can continue rollout but with a short observation window. proposal: roll forward the rest of us-west fleet in 10m, but pin v3.14 on canaries for 24h to monitor for recurrence. also add a line in release notes about transient prefill lag and mitigation steps.

liam: +1. i'll add an alert rule to watch embed route p99 and kv miss rate for the next 24h.

sara: updating release notes draft now: "v3.14.0 - rollout: gradual. Note: transient prefill delay observed in canaries affecting /v1/embed; mitigation: prefill job retried and complete, rollout resumed; monitoring and p99 alert enabled."

ana: also add operational playbook: if users report embed 503s after upgrade, trigger prefill for affected hosts and hold rollout.

sara: will send a short customer-facing blurb to #customers and attach internal release notes.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollforward to remainder of us-west in 10m from 6154321060.

liam: quick checklist for the oncall: 1) verify p99 < baseline 2) confirm prefill success on new hosts 3) watch error spikes -> escalate if >5% failure rate.

ana: I'll be on watch for next hour. ping me if anything looks off.

sara: thanks all. tagging :thumbsup: Good catch by smokebot.

smokebot: reaction :white_check_mark:.

liam: leaving a follow-up ticket in backlog: PRE-1234 "prefill retry resilience" to improve startup prefill feedback and retries.

sara: last note: holding release notes update under changelog/ops until post-rollforward verification passes.

ana: sounds good.

sara: will close thread after 24h observation or earlier if stable.
